caption: The drawing depicts a composition featuring a loosely rendered, blue-colored floral motif on a tan or beige background, with soft gradients and shading suggesting an area of diffuse color spreading out from the center. The flower has large, curving petals and broad leaves, painted with an almost watery or watercolor-like effect. Above the flower, the text "THARRINGTON LYONS" is written in an arch with a blocky font. To the right of the flower, there is a simple, thinly outlined jug or pitcher, also in blue, with a handle and a rounded body; faint blue shading decorates the top left area of the jug. In the top left area of the drawing, there is an indistinct round object with a halo-like outline, looking similar to a ring or a cup mark. The background is primarily uncolored, with a light beige tone. The signature “GEO. LOUGHRIDGE” appears faintly in the bottom left corner.
title: Jug
